stemMd: A courier leaves at 09:00 travelling at 30 km/h. A second leaves from the same place at 09:30 on the same route at 45 km/h. How many minutes after 09:30 does the second catch the first?
explanationMd: The first courier has a 15 km lead. The second closes it at relative speed 45−30=15 km/h, taking one hour, or 60 minutes after departure.
